content.text: {"screening_id":"SCR_000118","question_assessments":[{"domain_id":"D1","question_id":"1.1","agent_response":"Y","evidence_location":"Methods, Sections 2.1–2.2 and 2.4; Results, Section 3.1 and Table 1; Discussion limitations, page 6","evidence_summary":"SGLT2i treatment was not randomized. Users differed from non-users in EuroSCORE II, HFrEF, chronic lung disease, and baseline creatinine. The authors acknowledge residual unmeasured confounding.","rationale":"Clinical prescribing of SGLT2i and postoperative AKI share determinants such as diabetes, heart-failure severity, kidney disease, operative urgency, cardiovascular status, and other treatments. Thus, there is clear potential for confounding.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D1","question_id":"1.2","agent_response":"N","evidence_location":"Methods, Sections 2.2 and 2.4","evidence_summary":"Participants were assigned to fixed exposure groups according to recorded SGLT2i use within two weeks before surgery; follow-up was not split according to changes in treatment.","rationale":"The primary analysis compared baseline exposure groups rather than dividing person-time according to treatment received during follow-up.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D1","question_id":"1.3","agent_response":"PY","evidence_location":"Methods, Sections 2.1 and 2.4; Table 1","evidence_summary":"Electronic medical records supplied demographic and clinical variables, including EuroSCORE II, age, sex, body size, smoking, hypertension, chronic lung disease, stroke, dyslipidemia, creatinine, diabetes, HFrEF, and anemia. Details about validation of diagnoses and measurements were limited.","rationale":"Many important baseline domains were measured using routinely collected clinical data and standard laboratory values, but reliability was not fully documented and some relevant aspects, such as detailed heart-failure severity, urgency category, and concomitant medication use, were not reported.","agent_confidence":"Moderate"},{"domain_id":"D1","question_id":"1.4","agent_response":"PN","evidence_location":"Methods, Section 2.4; Supplementary File e1 referenced but not included in supplied PDF; Results, Sections 3.1–3.2","evidence_summary":"Entropy balancing controlled prespecified baseline variables and reportedly achieved exact mean balance. However, no adjustment was reported for several plausible confounders, including detailed cardiac function and heart-failure severity, urgent versus emergent status, preoperative hemodynamic status, other nephroprotective or nephrotoxic medications, and factors influencing SGLT2i prescribing.","rationale":"The weighting approach appropriately addressed measured confounders, but important residual confounding is plausible because treatment was clinically selected and not all key prognostic and prescribing factors were captured.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D1","question_id":"1.5","agent_response":"Y","evidence_location":"Methods, Sections 2.4–2.5; Results, Sections 3.2 and 3.5","evidence_summary":"The primary entropy-balanced analysis adjusted only for baseline covariates. Perioperative variables such as vasoactive support, transfusion, hypotension, catheterization, and cross-clamp time were included only in a separately identified sensitivity analysis estimating a controlled direct effect.","rationale":"The target primary total-effect estimate did not condition on post-intervention mediators. The potentially mediator-adjusted model was clearly presented as supplementary sensitivity analysis rather than the primary estimate.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D2","question_id":"2.1","agent_response":"Y","evidence_location":"Methods, Section 2.2; Figure 1; Discussion limitations, page 6","evidence_summary":"Eligibility required surviving to urgent or emergent isolated CABG with an SGLT2i indication and available laboratory data. Patients were excluded for missing data and for post-surgery mechanical circulatory support or reoperation within 72 hours, among other criteria.","rationale":"Availability of laboratory data and post-surgery events used for exclusion can be associated with both preoperative treatment and AKI risk, making selection related to intervention and outcome plausible.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D2","question_id":"2.2","agent_response":"Y","evidence_location":"Methods, Section 2.2; Figure 1","evidence_summary":"Exposure was preoperative SGLT2i use, while some eligibility decisions—including exclusion for postoperative mechanical circulatory support and reoperation within 72 hours—could only be made after exposure initiation and surgery.","rationale":"At least part of selection into the analyzed cohort occurred after the intervention had begun.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D2","question_id":"2.3","agent_response":"Y","evidence_location":"Methods, Section 2.2; Figure 1","evidence_summary":"The flow chart reports 222 exclusions for missing data, 14 for mechanical circulatory support, and 12 for reoperation. The distribution of these exclusions by SGLT2i exposure and AKI risk was not reported.","rationale":"Conditioning on postoperative complications or outcome-data availability could induce an exposure–outcome association, particularly because mechanical support and reoperation are strongly related to severe illness and AKI.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D2","question_id":"2.4","agent_response":"N","evidence_location":"Methods, Sections 2.4–2.5","evidence_summary":"Entropy balancing addressed measured baseline confounding, but no inverse-probability-of-selection weighting, imputation, quantitative selection-bias analysis, or other correction for cohort-selection processes was reported.","rationale":"The analysis did not specifically correct for selection caused by missing laboratory data or post-intervention exclusion criteria.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D3","question_id":"3.1","agent_response":"Y","evidence_location":"Methods, Section 2.2","evidence_summary":"Exposure was operationally defined as SGLT2i use within two weeks before surgery, determined from the electronic prescription database and preoperative anesthesia records; available agents were dapagliflozin and empagliflozin.","rationale":"The comparison groups had an explicit and reproducible operational definition, although the definition did not guarantee active drug use at surgery.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D3","question_id":"3.2","agent_response":"N","evidence_location":"Methods, Section 2.2; Discussion limitations, page 6","evidence_summary":"Exposure was reconstructed retrospectively from prescriptions and anesthesia records. Exact stopping dates were rarely or not systematically documented, and dosing was unavailable.","rationale":"Intervention information was not recorded at initiation in a study-specific manner and did not directly establish the timing of the last dose or adherence.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D3","question_id":"3.3","agent_response":"N","evidence_location":"Methods, Sections 2.1–2.2","evidence_summary":"Exposure was based on preoperative prescription and anesthesia records generated before postoperative AKI occurred.","rationale":"Although misclassification is plausible, the postoperative outcome could not reasonably influence preoperative treatment documentation, so classification was unlikely to depend on knowledge of the outcome.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D4","question_id":"4.1","agent_response":"NI","evidence_location":"Methods, Section 2.6; Discussion, pages 4–6","evidence_summary":"The center used standardized anesthesia and cardiopulmonary bypass protocols, but the study did not comprehensively report whether other aspects of usual care differed because patients were receiving SGLT2i.","rationale":"There is insufficient information to determine whether clinicians made systematic treatment changes beyond the intervention being compared.","agent_confidence":"Moderate"},{"domain_id":"D4","question_id":"4.2","agent_response":"PY","evidence_location":"Methods, Sections 2.5–2.6; Table 1; Results, Section 3.5","evidence_summary":"Measured perioperative factors—including vasoactive support, transfusion, hypotension, catheterization, and cross-clamp time—were similar or addressed in sensitivity analysis. Perioperative care followed a center protocol, but postoperative SGLT2i restart and other medications were not reliably captured.","rationale":"Major measured co-interventions were reasonably balanced or analyzed, although incomplete capture of medication and postoperative management prevents a definitive assessment.","agent_confidence":"Moderate"},{"domain_id":"D4","question_id":"4.3","agent_response":"N","evidence_location":"Methods, Section 2.2; Discussion limitations, page 6","evidence_summary":"A prescription or use record within 14 days was treated as exposure. Exact preoperative stopping times, dosing, adherence, and postoperative re-initiation were unavailable.","rationale":"The study could not verify that classified users actually had continued or physiologically active SGLT2i treatment at surgery, so implementation and adherence to the target exposure were inadequately established.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D4","question_id":"4.4","agent_response":"Y","evidence_location":"Methods, Sections 2.4–2.5; Results, Sections 3.2 and 3.5","evidence_summary":"The primary analysis estimated an ATE using entropy-balancing weights and weighted logistic regression with robust standard errors. A separate model examined perioperative factors.","rationale":"For a baseline-treatment total-effect estimand, the weighted analysis was methodologically appropriate, subject to residual confounding and exposure uncertainties assessed in other domains.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D5","question_id":"5.1","agent_response":"Y","evidence_location":"Methods, Sections 2.2–2.3; Results, Section 3.2; Figure 1","evidence_summary":"AKI results were reported for all 484 participants included in the analysis: 135 SGLT2i users and 349 non-users. Seven missing time-to-event records affected mortality analysis, not the AKI result.","rationale":"Within the final analyzed cohort, postoperative creatinine-based AKI status appears available for all or nearly all participants.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D5","question_id":"5.2","agent_response":"PN","evidence_location":"Methods, Section 2.2; Figure 1","evidence_summary":"The study reports determining exposure from prescription and anesthesia records and does not explicitly identify exclusions for missing SGLT2i status. The flow chart has a general missing-data category.","rationale":"Exclusion specifically because of missing intervention status was not reported, although the broad missing-data category leaves some uncertainty.","agent_confidence":"Moderate"},{"domain_id":"D5","question_id":"5.3","agent_response":"N","evidence_location":"Methods, Sections 2.2 and 2.4; Figure 1","evidence_summary":"The stated missing-data exclusion concerned key laboratory data needed for AKI definition. No exclusions specifically due to missing entropy-balancing covariates were described.","rationale":"There is no reported exclusion for missing adjustment covariates, distinct from the important exclusion for unavailable outcome-related laboratory data.","agent_confidence":"Moderate"},{"domain_id":"D5","question_id":"5.4","agent_response":"PY","evidence_location":"Methods, Sections 2.2–2.3; Figure 1","evidence_summary":"A total of 222 screened patients were excluded for missing data, including missing laboratory data required to define AKI. Their exposure distribution and clinical course were not provided.","rationale":"Availability and frequency of postoperative creatinine measurements may depend on illness course, duration of hospitalization, or complications and therefore could be related to the unobserved true AKI outcome.","agent_confidence":"Moderate"},{"domain_id":"D5","question_id":"5.5","agent_response":"N","evidence_location":"Methods, Sections 2.2 and 2.4; Figure 1","evidence_summary":"Patients with missing key laboratory data were excluded. No imputation, missingness weighting, sensitivity analysis, or outcome-data recovery procedure was reported for the AKI analysis.","rationale":"Complete-case exclusion was used without a method addressing potentially informative missing outcome data.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D6","question_id":"6.1","agent_response":"PN","evidence_location":"Methods, Section 2.3","evidence_summary":"AKI was defined from daily in-hospital serum creatinine measurements using KDIGO thresholds and preoperative creatinine as baseline.","rationale":"Serum creatinine is objective and threshold-based, making direct influence from knowledge of SGLT2i status unlikely, although clinical testing or discharge patterns could still affect ascertainment.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D6","question_id":"6.2","agent_response":"PY","evidence_location":"Methods, Sections 2.1–2.3","evidence_summary":"This was a retrospective, non-blinded medical-record study, and no blinded outcome adjudication was reported.","rationale":"Clinicians and data abstractors probably had access to medication records, although awareness is unlikely to materially alter an objective creatinine-defined outcome.","agent_confidence":"Moderate"},{"domain_id":"D6","question_id":"6.3","agent_response":"Y","evidence_location":"Methods, Section 2.3","evidence_summary":"The same baseline creatinine definition, daily serum creatinine measurements, seven-day window, and KDIGO thresholds were applied to both exposure groups.","rationale":"Outcome assessment methods were explicitly comparable across groups.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D6","question_id":"6.4","agent_response":"PN","evidence_location":"Methods, Section 2.3; Discussion limitations, page 6","evidence_summary":"Only serum creatinine criteria were used, which could under-detect AKI relative to combined creatinine and urine-output criteria, but there is no evidence that this limitation differed by SGLT2i status.","rationale":"Some outcome under-ascertainment is possible, but systematic differential measurement error related to intervention status is unlikely.","agent_confidence":"Moderate"},{"domain_id":"D7","question_id":"7.1","agent_response":"PN","evidence_location":"Methods, Section 2.3; Results, Section 3.2; Figure 2","evidence_summary":"The paper identifies seven-day creatinine-based KDIGO AKI as the primary outcome and reports overall AKI plus stage distributions. No prospective protocol or registration is cited for verification.","rationale":"The reported measurement is standard and matches the stated primary outcome, with no indication that it was chosen after examining alternatives, although lack of a protocol leaves some uncertainty.","agent_confidence":"Moderate"},{"domain_id":"D7","question_id":"7.2","agent_response":"PN","evidence_location":"Methods, Sections 2.4–2.5; Results, Sections 3.2 and 3.5","evidence_summary":"The paper describes the primary entropy-balanced model in advance in the Methods and reports both risk difference and risk ratio, along with a directionally consistent sensitivity analysis. No registered analysis plan was reported.","rationale":"Multiple possible analytic choices existed, but the main reported analyses are transparently described and concordant; there is no clear evidence of selective choice based on results.","agent_confidence":"Moderate"},{"domain_id":"D7","question_id":"7.3","agent_response":"PN","evidence_location":"Methods, Sections 2.3–2.5; Results, Sections 3.2 and 3.5; no protocol or registration reported","evidence_summary":"The stated primary analysis and sensitivity analysis were both reported, including confidence intervals and p-values. However, prospective specification cannot be verified.","rationale":"Finding-based selection is not indicated by the article, but cannot be definitively excluded without a time-stamped protocol or statistical analysis plan.","agent_confidence":"Moderate"}],"domain_assessments":[{"domain_id":"D1","provisional_domain_judgement":"Serious","domain_rationale":"Entropy balancing addressed many measured baseline characteristics, but this was a clinically selected prevalent-user comparison with marked baseline differences and plausible unmeasured confounding from operative urgency, detailed heart-failure and cardiovascular severity, concomitant medications, and treatment-selection factors. Residual confounding could materially affect the AKI estimate."},{"domain_id":"D2","provisional_domain_judgement":"Serious","domain_rationale":"Selection included a substantial missing-data exclusion and post-intervention exclusions for mechanical circulatory support and early reoperation. These factors are plausibly associated with both SGLT2i use and AKI, and no selection-bias correction was performed."},{"domain_id":"D3","provisional_domain_judgement":"Moderate","domain_rationale":"The operational intervention groups were clearly stated and determined before AKI, limiting outcome-dependent classification. However, use within a 14-day window, without exact last-dose timing, dosing, or adherence, creates meaningful exposure misclassification."},{"domain_id":"D4","provisional_domain_judgement":"Moderate","domain_rationale":"Measured perioperative co-interventions were similar or examined in sensitivity analysis, and the primary weighted analysis was appropriate for a baseline total-effect estimand. Nevertheless, actual continuation at surgery and postoperative treatment were not verified, and unmeasured care differences remain possible."},{"domain_id":"D5","provisional_domain_judgement":"Serious","domain_rationale":"AKI data were complete in the final cohort, but 222 screened patients were excluded for missing data, including laboratory information required to define AKI. Missingness could be outcome-related, and no imputation, weighting, or sensitivity analysis addressed it."},{"domain_id":"D6","provisional_domain_judgement":"Low","domain_rationale":"AKI was objectively determined using the same serum-creatinine-based KDIGO criteria in both groups. Assessors were probably not blinded and urine output was omitted, but differential measurement by SGLT2i status appears unlikely."},{"domain_id":"D7","provisional_domain_judgement":"Moderate","domain_rationale":"The target result was identified as primary, standard KDIGO measurement was used, and both primary and consistent sensitivity estimates were reported. However, no prospective protocol, registration, or time-stamped analysis plan was available to rule out selective choice among measurements or analyses."}],"agent_overall_provisional_judgement":"Serious","agent_overall_rationale":"The result is at serious risk of bias, driven principally by residual confounding, selection after exposure initiation—including exclusions related to postoperative course—and substantial exclusion for missing laboratory data without correction. Exposure timing and adherence were also uncertain. Objective, comparable AKI measurement reduces concern in the outcome-measurement domain, and no single issue clearly warrants a Critical judgement, but the estimated protective association could be materially distorted relative to a well-conducted randomized trial."}
